messages.subject: Custom input/output for pivoting DataTables?
parts:
Hi,

Is there any code available or already build package which would produce interactive controls - similar to pivot table in excel or google spreadsheet - which would transform DataTables output to expected shape?
The solution as for now which comes to my mind is three multiple selection lists, one for rows another for columns, third one for values. Plus some function selection to apply on values.
Yet it would not be elegant at all with my shiny skills, so I would prefer to reuse some well build code.
The best if it would utilize data.table (not DataTables) under the hood to perform pivoting as fast as possible to handle the own pivoting for each connected user. But if I would have a good input control for this I might pivot the data.table object at my own in shinyServer function, and just pass it to the outputDataTable(). So the output for pivot might not be necessary.

Regards,
Jan
